opportunities.title: Avoid multiple page redirects
opportunities.description: Redirects introduce additional delays before the page can be loaded. [Learn how to avoid page redirects](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/performance/redirects/).

opportunities.title: Minify CSS
opportunities.description: Minifying CSS files can reduce network payload sizes. [Learn how to minify CSS](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/performance/unminified-css/).

opportunities.title: Elements with an ARIA `[role]` that require children to contain a specific `[role]` are missing some or all of those required children.
opportunities.description: Some ARIA parent roles must contain specific child roles to perform their intended accessibility functions. [Learn more about roles and required children elements](https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.11/aria-required-children).

opportunities.title: Font display
opportunities.description: Consider setting [font-display](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/performance/insights/font-display) to swap or optional to ensure text is consistently visible. swap can be further optimized to mitigate layout shifts with [font metric overrides](https://developer.chrome.com/blog/font-fallbacks).

opportunities.title: Document request latency
opportunities.description: Your first network request is the most important. [Reduce its latency](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/performance/insights/document-latency) by avoiding redirects, ensuring a fast server response, and enabling text compression.

opportunities.title: Browser errors were logged to the console
opportunities.description: Errors logged to the console indicate unresolved problems. They can come from network request failures and other browser concerns. [Learn more about this errors in console diagnostic audit](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/best-practices/errors-in-console/)

opportunities.title: Links are not crawlable
opportunities.description: Search engines may use `href` attributes on links to crawl websites. Ensure that the `href` attribute of anchor elements links to an appropriate destination, so more pages of the site can be discovered. [Learn how to make links crawlable](https://support.google.com/webmasters/answer/9112205)

opportunities.title: List items (`<li>`) are not contained within `<ul>`, `<ol>` or `<menu>` parent elements.
opportunities.description: Screen readers require list items (`<li>`) to be contained within a parent `<ul>`, `<ol>` or `<menu>` to be announced properly. [Learn more about proper list structure](https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.11/listitem).
